Why are the TVS Group family members fighting? This video explains the big family dispute inside one of India’s top business groups. Learn about the conflict between Lakshmi Venu, Venu Srinivasan, Sudarshan Venu and Mallika Srinivasan. Understand why Lakshmi Venu is asking for her fair share of the family business and wealth against her brother Sudarshan. Watch till the end for the latest updates on this major Indian corporate family fight and what it means for the TVS Group.
